text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, dear Crown～♪ Happy 
birthday to you～～～～♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that was the birthday song! Thank 
you both so mu—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Shine bright~~~~~~, Crown~~~~♪ Just like a 
fixed staaar~~~, Crown~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
With fighting spirit in your heart, 
Crown~~!! March forward with courage, 
Crown~~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Aah...! You created an original part for 
me, thank you so mu—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
T-There's still more to it?! Just how long 
is this gonna go on...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
M-No problem...!! The two of you arranged 
this for me, after all. I'll listen all 
the way to the end and interpret it 
properly...!!
